title: The dashboard downloads three megabytes every four seconds
goal: The design dashboard re-downloads everything it knows about every task, including every task's full history, four times a minute. That is three megabytes a poll for a page that mostly needs a handful of numbers, and it will only get worse as the queue grows. Make the poll small so the dashboard stays instant on a slow machine and does not heat the fan.
notes: Measured on 2026-09-07 while rebuilding Ready to try: /api/state is 3,043,595 bytes, of which tasks is 2,556,307 and completed24h is 379,339. aggregateState() in queue/bin/queue-lib.mjs returns every task with its whole log array. The Ready to try tab already shows the shape of the fix: a slim list payload plus a detail endpoint fetched on demand (/api/audit-index and /api/audit/<name>). Same move here: strip log/notes/acceptance out of the state tasks array, keep them behind a /api/task/<id> the detail dialog fetches when it opens. The Tasks tab search matches against notes today, so either keep a short notes excerpt in the list or move that search server-side.
acceptance: The four-second poll carries well under 300KB with the current queue
Every tab still shows what it shows today, with no visible delay when you open one
Opening a task still shows its full history
